x: Heavy neutral leptons in low-scale type-I seesaw models can reveal their Majorana or Dirac nature at future $e^+e^-$ and $\mu^+\mu^-$ colliders via forward-backward angular distribution asymmetries.

t: Nuclear PDFs
a: K. Greve, T. Ježo, M. Klasen et al.
x: Global NLO analyses of nuclear PDFs (nCTEQ26 preliminary, EPPS21, nNNPDF3.0) and NNLO TUJU21 are systematically compared, highlighting data sensitivities, strange-sea constraints from neutrino DIS, and $A$-dependent uncertainty patterns.

t: Leptogenesis with a GeV-Scale Quasi-Dirac Neutrino
a: Stephen F. King, Soumen Kumar Manna, Rishav Roshan et al.
x: Thermal Higgs decays ($H\to LN$) in the early Universe generate the baryon asymmetry via GeV-scale quasi-Dirac neutrinos with symmetry-protected mass splitting, testable at SHiP, MATHUSLA, and FCC-ee.

t: The hadronic-vacuum-polarization contribution to the muon anomalous magnetic moment in isospin-symmetric lattice QCD with twisted-mass fermions
a: C. Alexandrou (Extended Twisted Mass Collaboration), S. Bacchio (Extended Twisted Mass Collaboration), A. De Santis (Extended Twisted Mass Collaboration) et al.
x: ETMC reports a high-precision lattice QCD determination of the leading-order hadronic vacuum polarization in isospin-symmetric QCD, yielding $a_\mu^{\rm HVP} = (714.9 \pm 8.1)\times 10^{-10}$, consistent with the Fermilab $(g-2)_\mu$ measurement.

t: $^6$He structure from semiclassical 3D models based on $\textit{ab initio}$ spatial correlations
a: Mengyao Huang, Tobias Frederico, Peng Yin et al.
x: Semiclassical 3D geometric models based on ab initio no-core shell model two-body spatial correlations reveal that the $\alpha$ core of $^6\text{He}$ is significantly flattened by valence halo neutrons.

t: DUNE Beam-Energy Dependence of Sensitivity to the Violation of the Equivalence Principle
a: Monjowara Khatun, Debajyoti Dutta
x: A DUNE simulation demonstrates that the Low-Energy beam tune provides superior sensitivity to violations of the equivalence principle over the Medium-Energy tune by concentrating statistics at the first oscillation maximum.

t: Gallium Anomaly and Solar Neutrinos
a: Steven R. Elliott, R. G. Hamish Robertson
x: Calibrating the solar neutrino flux with elastic scattering and SNO neutral-current measurements yields a predicted $^{71}\text{Ga}$ rate matching Gallex/SAGE, showing the Gallium Anomaly does not stem from cross sections or detection efficiencies.

t: Machine-learning-based neutrino-event generation constrained by experimental measurements
a: Jose Luis Bonilla, Krzysztof M. Graczyk, Rwik Dharmapal Banerjee et al.
x: A generative surrogate for $\nu_\mu$-nucleus scattering combines a cross-section DNN and cGAN, enabling calibration directly to unfolded, smeared MicroBooNE differential cross sections via differentiable histogramming without event-level experimental data.

t: Can bosenovae deplete the galactic dark matter?
a: Samuel Gómez Gómez, Joshua Eby
x: Calculates whether bosenovae of gravitational atoms and boson stars can significantly deplete galactic dark matter halos.

t: Thermalization of the Primordial Stochastic Gravitational-Wave Background
a: Hongguang Zhang, Zhengyang Qiu, Sirui Wang et al.
x: Examines self-interaction and thermalization of high-occupation primordial gravitons from inflation into a Bose-Einstein distribution.

t: Audible curvaton: modulated phase transition as the origin of large-scale curvature perturbations and gravitational wave anisotropies
a: Wen-Yuan Ai, Gabriele Franciolini, Xin Wang et al.
x: Proposes a post-inflationary phase transition generating curvature perturbations and stochastic gravitational waves.

t: Top-Quark Mass Scheme Uncertainties in Higgs Boson Pair Production via Gluon Fusion
a: Clara Del Pio, Sebastian Jaśkiewicz, Rebecca von Kuk et al.
x: Calculates top-quark mass scheme uncertainties in Higgs pair production, which is outside the reader's neutrino physics focus.

t: Fast Monte Carlo calculation of multiple scattering in resonant neutron capture
a: R. M. Djilkibaev
x: Develops a fast Monte Carlo code to calculate multiple neutron scattering and capture resonances in samples.

t: MoEDAL-MAPP: the first dedicated search experiment at the LHC
a: John R. Ellis, Nick E. Mavromatos, Vasiliki A. Mitsou et al.
x: Special issue covering the MoEDAL-MAPP experiment at the LHC searching for anomalously ionizing and highly charged particles.

t: Quantum-enhanced Search for Galactic Dark Photons Using Cat-State Cavities
a: Aoying Wang, Yanjie Zeng, Yanyan Cai et al.
x: Reinterprets quantum-enhanced superconducting circuit cavity data to set bounds on Galactic dark-photon backgrounds.

t: Radion/Dilaton portal freeze-in dark matter in extra-dimensional theories
a: Amrita Mukherjee, George Sanamyan, Dipan Sengupta
x: Analyzes freeze-in dark matter via a radion/dilaton portal in stabilized warped extra-dimensional models.

t: Quasiparticle Modeling of Strongly Magnetized Strange Quark Systems
a: Yogesh Kumar, Manas Lohani, Poonam Jain et al.
x: Examines spin-polarized strange quark matter and strange stars using a quasiparticle model under strong magnetic fields.

t: Effects of quadratic frequency chirping and carrier-envelope phase on Schwinger pair production in polarized electric fields
a: Abhinav Jangir
x: Investigates electron-positron pair production in polarized electric fields with frequency chirping using the Dirac-Heisenberg-Wigner formalism.

t: Strangeness suppression, the $\phi$ meson and $\Lambda\bar\Lambda$ spin correlations from exact strangeness conservation at the quark level
a: P. Castorina, H. Satz
x: Examines exact strangeness conservation at the quark level to explain suppression and spin correlations in small collision systems.

t: Displaced tracks as a signal of dark matter co-annihilation: a case study using inert doublet model at $e^+e^-$ collider
a: Hrishikesh Deka, Subhaditya Bhattacharya, Amir Subba et al.
x: Explores displaced tracks and disappearing charged states from dark matter co-annihilation within the Inert Doublet Model at lepton colliders.

t: Thermal properties of the $\rho$ meson from a machine-learning-improved holographic QCD model
a: Jia-Jie Jiang, Han Tang, Danning Li et al.
x: Uses a machine-learning-improved holographic QCD model to study thermal spectral functions and quasi-normal modes of the rho meson.

t: Measurement of Born cross sections of $e^+e^-\to pK^{-}\bar\Sigma^{0}$ + c.c. at $\sqrt{s}$ = 3.5-4.9 GeV and partial wave analysis at $\sqrt{s}$ = 3.773 GeV
a: BESIII Collaboration, M. Ablikim, M. N. Achasov et al.

t: Achieving a 0.49 keV threshold in the COSINE-100 dark matter experiment
a: J. Kim (COSINE-100 Collaboration), N. Carlin (COSINE-100 Collaboration), D. F. F. S. Cavalcante (COSINE-100 Collaboration) et al.
x: Achieves a 0.49 keV threshold in the COSINE-100 dark matter experiment using machine learning waveform classification, relevant to low-energy nuclear recoil detection techniques.

t: Collective-flow signatures of bubble nuclei in intermediate-energy projectile fragmentation reactions
a: Ge Ren, Chun-Wang Ma, Xi-Guang Cao et al.
x: Investigates collective flow and fragment yields of bubble nuclei in intermediate-energy projectile fragmentation using quantum molecular dynamics.

t: R-process nuclei in the rare-earth region above N=126 in Relativistic Hartree-Bogoliubov theory: A preponderance of shape-coexistence in nuclei
a: M. M. Sharma
x: Investigates shape coexistence and shell structure in extreme neutron-rich nuclei near the r-process path using relativistic Hartree-Bogoliubov theory.

t: Thermal spectral functions of heavy and exotic Mesons from a hQCD at finite density
a: Zhou-Run Zhu, Zhanyuan Gao, Zhaohui Feng et al.
x: Computes thermal spectral functions for heavy and exotic mesons using a holographic Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton model at finite density.

t: Strange-quark-number-dependent response to partonic dynamics in baryon-rich Au+Au collisions
a: Di Zhao, Xun Zhu, Gao-Chan Yong
x: Identifies strange-quark-number-dependent responses to partonic dynamics in heavy-ion collisions, relevant to nuclear matter transport and strangeness production.

t: Effective Fermion-Photon Vertex in a Rotating Relativistic Medium: Tree-Level Structure
a: Jorge David Castaño-Yepes, Alejandro Ayala, J. E. Martínez-Herrera et al.
x: Evaluates the tree-level fermion-photon effective vertex in a rigidly rotating relativistic medium, touching on quantum field theory under external conditions.

t: Two-loop $gg\to AA$ amplitudes near threshold and the double parton scattering singularity
a: Arunima Bhattacharya
x: Analyzes two-loop amplitudes and double parton scattering singularities for pseudoscalar production in gluon fusion, touching on perturbative QCD factorization.

t: Evolution of multihadron fragmentation functions with nonperturbative behavior
a: K. Makino, T. C. Rogers
x: Develops a formalism to evolve collinear multihadron fragmentation functions while separating out intrinsic mass scales and nonperturbative partonic structures.

t: Transport of hard probes in the glasma
a: Dana Avramescu
x: Studies jet and heavy quark transport through the glasma stage of heavy-ion collisions using classical Yang-Mills equations and light-front Hamiltonian methods.

t: Decoherence as a Detector-Resolution Flow
a: Yao Ji, Yuqi Wang
x: Models QED final-state radiation and open quantum system decoherence as a detector-resolution flow, touching on quantum coherence and final states.

t: Binding energies in the $0^{-+}$ and $1^{--}$ fermion--antifermion channels from the ladder Bethe-Salpeter and Schr\"odinger equations
a: Wei He, Hai-Qing Zhou
x: Calculates binding energies of fermion-antifermion systems using ladder Bethe-Salpeter and Schrödinger equations, useful for understanding bound-state dynamics and potential models.

t: Bottom-Charm $[bc]$ Diquark Masses from QCD Laplace Sum-Rules
a: T. de Oliveira, D. Harnett, J. Ho et al.
x: Calculates bottom-charm diquark masses using QCD Laplace sum rules, providing inputs for multi-quark hadronic states relevant to nonperturbative QCD.

t: Exothermic dark-photon dark matter and the LZ high-recoil event: finite-reheating constraints
a: Kuldeep Deka
x: Examines freeze-in and finite-reheating constraints for an exothermic dark matter candidate linked to the LZ high-recoil event, intersecting with direct detection backgrounds.

t: A low-cost compact muon detector for millikelvin operation
a: Tengiz Ibrayev, Danish Khan, Alex Herscovics et al.
x: Presents a low-cost compact muon detector operating at millikelvin temperatures inside dilution refrigerators to tag cosmic ray muons for superconducting qubit error mitigation.

t: Prospects for modelling odd and odd-odd nuclei using energy density functionals
a: A. V. Afanasjev, B. Bally, M. Bender et al.
x: Examines microscopic modeling of odd and odd-odd nuclei using EDFs, providing relevant nuclear structure context for neutrino-nucleus interaction calculations.

t: Constraint on particle mass of dark matter based on XTE J1814-338 observation and DANS model
k: Dark matter particle mass from NS
a: Lin Wang, Dehua Wen
x: Uses neutron star observations (XTE J1814-338) and dark matter admixture models to constrain sub-GeV to GeV dark matter particle masses.

t: Stabilizer R\'enyi Entropy Without a Phase Reference
a: Jinwei Chu, Savan Kharel
x: Introduces a phase-invariant stabilizer Rènyi entropy applied to tree-level multi-particle gluon and helicity scattering amplitudes.

t: Measurement of electromagnetic transition form factors in two-photon collisions at BESIII
a: Max Lellmann (on behalf of the BESIII collaboration)
x: Reviews electromagnetic transition form factors and hadronic light-by-light scattering inputs from two-photon collisions at BESIII, essential for reducing hadronic uncertainties in electroweak and muon $g-2$ contexts.

t: Brownian GPDs: A Stochastic Calculus Approach to Generalized Parton Distributions from Integral Constraints
a: Douglas Q. Adams, Simonetta Liuti, Zaki Panjsheeri et al.
x: Presents a stochastic calculus and Langevin approach for modeling generalized parton distributions from lattice QCD moments without assuming rigid functional forms.

t: Spin and 3D structure: theoretical advances
a: Markus Diehl
x: Review of theoretical advances in spin-dependent parton distributions, transverse-momentum distributions, GPDs, and power corrections, highly relevant to nucleon structure functions.

t: The dead-cone effect in charm, bottom and top quark jets in angular and momentum space
a: Redamy Perez-Ramos, Stefan Kluth, Wolfgang Ochs
x: Investigates the mass-dependent dead-cone effect in charm, bottom, and top quark jets using angular distributions and momentum spectra, closely aligned with perturbative QCD and heavy-quark fragmentation.

t: The Semileptonic B Frontier: LHC, B-factories, Lattice QCD & the Hunt for Precision
a: F. De Fazio, P. De Simone, M. Fedele et al.
x: Comprehensive workshop review on semileptonic B decays, lattice QCD, CKM matrix elements, and form factor extractions, highly relevant to precision electroweak and heavy-flavor inputs.

t: Constraints on pion parton distributions at small $x$ from leading-neutron electroproduction data
a: C. Yang, P. C. Barry, W. Melnitchouk et al.
x: Global QCD analysis of pion parton distribution functions using leading-neutron electroproduction data, highly relevant to understanding pion structure and neutrino-induced pion production backgrounds.

t: Born-Oppenheimer chiral effective field theory and its application to $X_b$
a: Yu Zhang, Feng-Kun Guo, Christoph Hanhart et al.
x: Formulates Born-Oppenheimer chiral EFT in momentum space to describe the $1^{++}$ bottomonium spectrum, predicting that the observed $\chi_{b1}(3P)$ is a molecular $X_b$ and identifying an undiscovered compact partner.

t: Transient PULSE: Code for the Transient Propagation of UltraLight (pseudo)Scalars to Earth
a: Jason Arakawa, Charles Cheung, Muhammad Hani Zaheer et al.
x: Presents Transient PULSE, a Python software package that simulates the propagation, dispersion, and medium-screening of transient ultralight scalar and pseudoscalar bursts from astrophysical transients to terrestrial detectors.

t: Correlation of galactic very-high-energy gamma-ray sources detected by LHAASO with high-energy neutrinos
a: Long-Yu Zhang, Kai Wang
x: Demonstrates that the spatial coincidence between 90 LHAASO very-high-energy gamma-ray sources and 348 IceCube high-energy track alerts is statistically consistent with random background.

t: Constraining three-nucleon forces in nuclear lattice effective field theory
a: Serdar Elhatisari, Ulf-G. Meißner, Zhengxue Ren et al.
x: Constrains short-range chiral three-nucleon forces in nuclear lattice effective field theory at N3LO using nuclear binding energies up to $A=40$ and neutron-alpha scattering data.

t: Pythia-Contrib: a modular contribution framework for the Pythia 8 event generator
a: Benoit Assi, Christian Bierlich, Rikab Gambhir et al.
x: Introduces Pythia-Contrib, a modular runtime plugin framework allowing third-party developers to contribute new models and external dependencies to Pythia 8 without modifying or bloating the core codebase.

t: Measuring $V_{cb}$ at electron-proton colliders
a: David Marzocca
x: Bottom-tagged charged-current deep-inelastic scattering ($e^- c \to \nu_e b$) at future electron-proton colliders like the LHeC and FCC-eh can measure $|V_{cb}|$ with sub-percent precision, independent of semileptonic $B$ decays.

t: Universal enhancement of the pairing gap in a dilute Fermi superfluid
k: Universal pairing gap in dilute Fermi gas
a: Silas R. Beane, Roland C. Farrell, Cameron P. Shotwell
x: The pairing gap in a dilute Fermi superfluid exhibits a trans-series expansion where low-energy virtual quasiparticles generate a large linear-in-gap correction that enhances the gap beyond the Gor'kov-Melik-Barkhudarov prediction.

t: Coherent states of neutrinos in rotating matter
a: Alexander Breev, Maxim Dvornikov
x: Generalized coherent states for massless Dirac neutrinos electroweakly interacting with rotating matter are constructed in light-cone variables, yielding an effective mass and a smooth transition to plane waves.

t: Excited-State Effects in Nucleon Sigma Terms from a Variational Analysis
k: Excited-state effects in nucleon sigma terms
a: Constantia Alexandrou, Giannis Koutsou, Yan Li et al.
x: A variational GEVP analysis with multihadron $N\sigma$ interpolators and Laplace filtering suppresses excited-state contamination in lattice QCD extractions of nucleon scalar sigma-terms at physical pion masses.

t: Direct Detection of Solar Neutrinos to Probe Tensions and Break Degeneracies in Long-Baseline Neutrino Experiments
a: Dorian W. P. Amaral, David Cerdeño, Andrew Cheek et al.
x: Solar neutrino CEvNS and electron scattering in dark matter direct detection experiments can break parameter degeneracies in long-baseline neutrino experiments and constrain non-standard neutrino interaction solutions to the NOvA-T2K tension.
